description_en: Queries the real-time SNAT performance ranking of a NAT gateway
description_zh: 调用GetNatTopN接口，获取NAT网关的SNAT转发实时数据排名
kebab_example: aliyun nis get-nat-topn --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-sample000 --begin-time 1638239092000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetNatTopN

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the NAT gateway is deployed
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query in milliseconds. If you do not specify EndTime, the point in time specified by BeginTime is queried
parameters.help_zh: 查询指标的开始毫秒时间戳。如果不指定EndTime，则查询的是BeginTime指定的时间点的情况
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query in milliseconds. The time range specified by BeginTime and EndTime cannot exceed 86400000 milliseconds (24 hours)
parameters.help_zh: 查询指标的结束毫秒时间戳。BeginTime和EndTime的最大差距不能超过24小时，即86400000
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The metric that is used for real-time SNAT performance ranking. Valid values:

InBps: inbound data transfer. Unit: bit/s.
OutBps: outbound data transfer. Unit: bit/s.
InPps: inbound packet forwarding rate. Unit: packets per second.
OutPps: outbound packet forwarding rate. Unit: packets per second.
NewSessionPerSecond: new connection creation rate. Unit: connections per second.
ActiveSessionCount: number of concurrent connections. Unit: connections
parameters.help_zh:
对NAT网关进行SNAT转发实时数据排名的指标。取值：
InBps：入方向流量。单位：bps。
OutBps：出方向流量。单位：bps。
InPps：入方向包速率。单位：个/秒。
OutPps：出方向包速率。单位：个/秒。
NewSessionPerSecond：新建连接数。单位：个/秒。
ActiveSessionCount：并发连接数。单位：个
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return for real-time SNAT performance ranking. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 查询NAT网关的SNAT转发实时数据排名的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: topn

parameters.help_en: Query ranking statistics for a specific IP address. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify TopN or OrderBy
parameters.help_zh: 查询指定IP地址的监控指标。当输入Ip参数时，无需输入TopN和OrderBy
parameters.name: ip

IsTopNOpen.description_en:
Indicates whether Network Intelligence Service (NIS) is activated. The NatGatewayTopN parameter returns an empty array when NIS is not activated.

true: activated
false: not activated
IsTopNOpen.description_zh:
是否已开通网络智能服务(NIS)功能，未开通时NatGatewayTopN返回空。
true：已开通。
false：未开通

NatGatewayTopN.description_en: An array of statistics about real-time SNAT performance ranking
NatGatewayTopN.description_zh: NAT网关SNAT转发实时数据排名数组

items.description_en: The fields that are included in the statistics about real-time SNAT performance ranking. The values of the fields are averages within the time range from BeginTime to EndTime
items.description_zh: NAT网关SNAT转发实时数据排名对象。以下指标取BeginTime到EndTime的均值

ActiveSessionCount.description_en: The number of concurrent connections. Unit: connections

InBps.description_en: The inbound data transfer. Unit: bit/s

InFlowPerMinute.description_en: This field is reserved and not in use

InPps.description_en: The inbound packet forwarding rate. Unit: packets per second
InPps.description_zh: 入方向包速率。单位：个/秒

NewSessionPerSecond.description_en: The new connection creation rate. Unit: connections per second

OutBps.description_en: The outbound data transfer. Unit: bit/s

OutFlowPerMinute.description_en: This field is reserved and not in use

OutPps.description_en: The outbound packet forwarding rate. Unit: packets per second
OutPps.description_zh: 出方向包速率。单位：个/秒
